title: Canine Cosmonaut
note: Drawn off dog-01, which sets the field, the crop and the line weight for the set.
scene: Flat vector-style portrait: crisp clean edges, flat colour fills, at most two tones per surface — one light, one shadow — with no gradient between them. No airbrushing, no soft blurred shading, no photorealistic fur or fabric texture, no glossy highlights, no drop shadow, no outline heavier than a hairline. Simplified but not childish: the proportions and the anatomy stay accurate. Square 1:1. The background is one flat field of pale lavender-grey #eae7f0, edge to edge, with no gradient, no vignette, no shadow behind the subject and no texture. It is identical in every picture in this set — the twenty-four are seen side by side in a grid, and a field that drifts between them reads as a patchwork. One subject, large and centred, filling most of the frame. It is only ever seen inside a CIRCULAR MASK at small sizes, so everything that identifies the subject must sit inside the centred circle that touches the edges — nothing that matters in the corners, and no part of the head or ears clipped by that circle. Head and shoulders in clean three-quarter view facing right, no hands and no dog. The subject is twenties, close-cropped dark hair, a high padded mustard collar like a flight suit, looking slightly upward.
mustBeTrue: the background is one flat unshaded field of #eae7f0 with no gradient or shadow, the rendering is flat two-tone with no airbrushing or glossy highlights, and the subject is centred and complete inside a circular mask that touches the frame edges
